Asha (CS): Quick heads-up — Solstice Health QBR next Wed. Need a short cost section: current burn, 3 token drivers, any onboarding gaps that impact spend, and 1-2 enablement asks. Can we lock this by EOD tomorrow? @Sam FinOps @Lena (Solutions)
Sam FinOps: Yep — I can pull the spend/forecast. Current month tokens ~1.12M, est next month ~1.45M. Will break down by route.
Lena (Solutions): I have two enablement asks from the onboarding team: 1) a quick prompt-rewrite session to reduce expensive long generations, 2) a checklist for model/route pinning before go-live.
Ravi (AE): FYI customer flagged renewal concerns if costs spike >20% QoQ. They asked for a cost playbook demo in the QBR.
Asha (CS): Good catch, Ravi. Add that as a renewal risk item and include mitigation options (dedicated pool, batching/kV cache).
Sam FinOps: Draft numbers — putting them here for quick eyeball:
```
Current month: 1,120,000 tokens (~$16,800)
Projected next month (no mitigations): 1,450,000 tokens (~$21,750)
Top token drivers: embeddings-heavy search, nightly batch re-rank jobs, long-context assistant chats
```
Lena (Solutions): Can you split “long-context assistant chats” into interactive vs background completion? We can recommend truncation + summary caching for background jobs.
Sam FinOps: Sure. Quick split: interactive ~45% of assistant tokens, background jobs ~30%, embeddings & misc ~25%.
OnboardBot: Solstice Health onboarding progress: 78% complete. Pending: data ingest validation (2 pipelines), prompt tuning session. ETA: 5 business days.
Asha (CS): Perfect — put pending data ingest as a risk to spend (bad ingest -> noisy prompts -> higher tokens).
Ravi (AE): For the QBR slide, customer wants an explicit action: a 30-day cost guardrail plan. Can we propose a 10% throttling policy + canary dedicated capacity?
Lena (Solutions): We can propose: (a) summary-caching + prefix caching for assistant, (b) scheduled rerank batching overnight, (c) optional dedicated pool for peak traffic. Also offer a prompt workshop as enablement.
Sam FinOps: I'll produce two forecast scenarios for the slide: baseline, and mitigated (with our suggested levers). Will attach a 1-slide table and a 1-paragraph recommendation.
Asha (CS): Action items: Sam — slide + 2 scenarios by EOD tomorrow. Lena — 1-line enablement asks + workshop blurb. Ravi — confirm customer interest in dedicated pool (ask before QBR). I'll own the renewal-risk language and the QBR talking points.
Ravi (AE): Will ping customer now and circle back.
Lena (Solutions): +1, will draft the workshop blurb.
Sam FinOps: On it. I'll post the draft slide to this thread when ready. :thumbsup:
Asha (CS): Thanks team. Small ask — keep the QBR cost section to a single slide and one appendix slide with the numbers. If anyone gets objections from product/legal on the proposed mitigations, flag here.
Ravi (AE): Noted.
Asha (CS): Done — closing loop after drafts.
